message:
So, a while ago, I saw an NSFW bot that involved a box and cartoon rabbits of exaggerated proportions... So, ladies and gentlemen, I took inspiration and made this:
https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Closet_of_infinite_Goons~51b490f0eed7e5b3979e91ab104cca27.gz
Behold - The Closet of infinite Goons!
Ever wanted your own semi-disposable team to go out and rob fictional banks and jewlery stores with?
Ever wanted to LARP as a modern-day Al-Capone?
Wonder no more, gentlemen and ladies, as this closet provides you an unlimited subscription to unlimited manpower, for the low low low price of FREE!
(Disclaimer: food, water, and jobs for your goons not provided)
